MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  May 6, 2019

  A regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to
  order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills
  Estates, CA 90274, by CHAIR ZIGRANG.

  2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT led those assembled in the salute to the flag

  3.  ROLL CALL

  COMMISSIONER’S PRESENT:  Schachter, Scott, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo,
  Edler

  COMMISSIONER’S ABSENT:  Medawar

  STAFF PRESENT:  Planning Director Wahba, Associate Planner Thom,
  Administrative Assistant Corea

  4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  APPROVAL OF PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF APRIL 1, 2019

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO
  to,

  APPROVE THE DRAFT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES OF
  APRIL 1, 2019

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered

  5.  AUDIENCE ITEMS

  None

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS PRESENTED FOR
  CONSIDERATION TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION WILL BE WAIVED AND ALL
  SUCH ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS WILL BE READ BY TITLE ONLY.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by VICE CHAIR CARMAN to,

  APPROVE ITEM 6-A

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-04-19; LOCATION: 3 CLEAR VISTA DRIVE;
  APPLICANT: MS. SAGHIK WARTAN; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is
  requested to add single and second story additions to an existing single family home.

  Associate Planner Thom presented a PowerPoint presentation summarizing the staff
  report. This item was continued from the April 1, 2019 Planning Commission meeting. She
  stated that the applicant made some revisions as suggested by members of the Planning
  Commission, however, no changes were made to the size, which is proposed to be 5,759
  sq. ft.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that staff is not able to support the project and
  recommends that the Planning Commission deny the project as presented.

Planning Commission Meeting  1
May 6, 2019 Minutes
   Commissioner Yoo disclosed that his property is within the 500’ radius of the project site
  and recused himself from this item.

  Sina Khajavi, SK Architects, 4040 Palos Verdes Drive North, Suite 201, stated that the
  neighborhood includes various architectural styles. He stated that the entry was lowered;
  the office structure was lowered twelve inches and noted that they are below the allowable
  height; a Juliette balcony was added, but is not useful to the property owner and too low.
  Mr. Khajavi requested that the new proposed plan be approved less the Juliette balcony.
  He also added that the front of the home is 64 ft. from the property line.

  Edmond Tajirian, Owner, 3 Clear Vista Drive, provided a presentation showing the
  previous design and the new proposed design. He also provided examples of homes,
  which he opined, are more dramatic than the proposed design. He stated that he believes
  this design is within the rules of the City and requested that the Planning Commission
  reconsider their previous proposal. He added that he believes that changes to the
  architects design will ruin the aesthetic of the home. Mr. Tajirian stated that the neighbors
  agree that this will be an improvement to the neighborhood.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that 6 Clear Vista (used as an example) was a home
  that was built prior to Neighborhood Compatibility’s existence and commented that he
  does not believe this design would be approved today. He stated that many of the
  examples are designed in a way that reduces the massing and bulk to the facade.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT stated that the city has a 5,000 sq. ft. guideline which has been
  ignored and stated that he believes there have been no material change in the design and
  cannot support this project.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER stated that he does not believe there were any
  substantial changes to the design. As he recalls, there were two to three designs with
  recommendations from staff and the applicant elected not to consider those
  recommendations. COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER stated that in terms of compatibility,
  he does not believe this has been met; scale may or may not be an issue; style – the
  applicant may have indicated that this is a new design for the neighborhood. The
  introduction of new designs is something that needs to be determined by the City Council.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG stated that at the last meeting, the commission asked that the front
  entrance and office be lowered and they have been. The only thing not reduced is the
  square footage. He stated that it is a good design and the neighborhood needs a good
  design. CHAIR ZIGRANG stated that the design has a classic feel and he is in favor of
  this project.

  COMMISSIONER EDLER stated that some of the recommendations made at the last
  meeting have been met. He could go with or without the Juliette balcony.
  COMMISSIOENR EDLER stated that he has concern with the square footage but he could
  support the project.

  VICE CHAIR CARMAN expressed her concern with the scale of the project and stated
  that the city’s ranch style should be maintained. VICE CHAIR CARMAN stated that she
  objects to this project and supports staff’s recommendation.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG provided the applicant with the option to continue this item and make
  changes to the design or continue with a vote.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG stated that the fact that the HOA and neighbors are in support and
  welcome this improvement to their neighborhood speaks volumes.

  CHAIR SCHACTHER stated that if the design accepted in neighborhoods will change, this
  is something that needs to be reviewed by the City Council.

  VICE CHAIR CARMAN stated that the community maintains a rural nature and stated that
  this design does not fit and the scale is an issue. Approving this application would set a
  precedence. She thanked the applicant for their efforts in trying to accommodate the
  recommendations of the commission.

Planning Commission Meeting  2
May 6, 2019 Minutes
   A brief discussion ensued on the scale of this project as compared to homes in
  surrounding neighborhoods.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER
  to,
  APPROVE STAFF’S RECOMMENDATION TO DENY THIS APPLICATION ON
  THE BASIS OF THE LACK OF NEIGHBORHOOD COMPATIBILITY AND
  EXCEEDING THE CITY COUNCIL’S POLICY GUIDELINES ON SIZE.

  Ayes: Schachter, Scott, Carman
  Noes: Zigrang, Edler
  Absent: Medawar
  Abstain: Yoo

  Planning Director Wahba stated that Planning Application No. 04-19 has been denied.
  There is a 20-day appeal period and this decision may be appealed to the City Council.

  B.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-07-19; APPLICANT: MR. AND MRS. DAVID CHUNG;
  LOCATION: 42 CLUB VIEW LANE; A Neighborhood Compatibility Determination is
  requested for one and two-story additions to an existing two-story residence. A Minor
  Deviation is requested to decrease the front yard area by less than 10% and for the
  encroachment of the proposed addition into the required front yard which does not project
  closer to the property line than the forwardmost building line.

  Associate Planner Thom provided a presentation on Planning Application No. PA-07-19
  summarizing the staff report.

  Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission
  approve PA-07-19 with the condition that the existing unpermitted trellis located in
  the front yard be relocated to the side yard and that after-the-fact building permits be
  required for the structure since it is over 120 sq. ft.

  Jai Yang, Architect, stated that there are favorable views from this home. He provided an
  overview of the project and stated that there will be no change to the architectural
  style of the home.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Mr. Yang stated that the property
  owner has agreed to remove the gazebo (trellis).

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER EDLER to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-07-19 PURSUANT TO STAFF’S
  CONDITIONS OF APPROVAL WHICH INCLUDE THE REMOVAL OF THE
  TRELLIS.

  Ayes: Schachter, Scott, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo, Edler
  Noes:
  Absent: Medawar
  Abstain:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  8.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-05-19; APPLICANT: MR. AND MRS. GARY
  CAMPBELL; LOCATION: 2620 PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH; A Neighborhood
  Compatibility Determination is requested for a new retaining wall in the side and front
  yards. A Variance is request for the retaining wall to exceed the five foot maximum
  height allowed. A Grading Permit Application is required for this project.

  Associate Planner Thom provided a presentation summarizing the staff report for Planning
  Application No. PA-05-19. She added that the need to replace the retaining wall was
  discovered during the building plan check process for a project which was previously
  approved. Engineering firm, Hamilton and Associates, determined that the wall is
  distressed and needs to be replaced soon.

Planning Commission Meeting  3
May 6, 2019 Minutes
   Associate Planner Thom stated that staff recommends that the Planning Commission,
  open the public hearing; take public testimony; discuss the issues; close the public
  hearing; and, adopt Resolution No. PA-05-19 approving the project.

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT asked if granting this Variance will regularize this preexisting
  non-conforming retaining wall. Planning Director Wahba confirmed this.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG opened the public hearing.

  George Sweeney, Architect, provided a presentation with an overview of the project. He
  added that there are special circumstances due to the condition of the existing wall, which
  could be a hazard to the people using the bridle trail and this will also serve to maintain
  access to the public trail system. They also have full support of the neighbors.

  In response to a question by COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Mr. Sweeney stated that a drip
  system will be used to irrigate the foliage on the wall.

  Gary Campbell, Property Owner, stated that neighbors are in support of this project. He
  provided a brief history on the trail adjacent to this retaining wall.

  COMMISSIONER CARMAN thanked the applicant for their commitment to the community
  and are pleased with this proposed project.

  CHAIR ZIGRANG closed the public hearing.

  COMMISSIONER SCHACHTER made a motion, seconded by COMMISSIONER
  CARMAN to,

  APPROVE PLANNING APPLICATION NO. PA-05-19.

  Ayes: Schachter, Scott, Zigrang, Carman, Yoo, Edler
  Noes:
  Absent: Medawar
  Abstain:

  Planning Director Wahba stated that there is a 20-day appeal period for this item.

  9.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT commented on the construction fence at 9 Lantana.

  10.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

  Planning Director Wahba announced the following:

  •  Doug Prichard, City Manager will be retiring on July 8th.
  •  Andy Clark, Community Services Director will be retiring in June.
  •  City Hall is currently being remodeled.

  Per the request of VICE CHAIR CARMAN, Planning Director Wahba provided an update
  on the General Plan Update consultants.

  Per the request of COMMISSIONER SCOTT, Planning Director Wahba provided an
  update on the horse trail on Palos Verdes Drive East adjacent to the Rolling Hills Country
  Club.

  11.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS, APRIL 23, 2019

  B.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, APRIL 15, 2019

  COMMISSIONER SCOTT moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER YOO to,

Planning Commission Meeting  4
May 6, 2019 Minutes
   RECEIVE AND FILE ITEM 11-A and 11-B

  There being no objection, CHAIR ZIGRANG so ordered.

  12.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR ZIGRANG adjourned the meeting at 8:28 p.m. to the next Planning Commission
  meeting on June 3, 2019.

Planning Commission Meeting  5
May 6, 2019 Minutes
